title: ml.v1
description: One JSON object on one line. ok is false exactly when errors is present; error is its first element. A dry run (fit --dry-run) has ok true, exit 9, dry_run and planned_actions. No float appears: every decimal is a string with its digits exact.

text_or_bytes.description: UTF-8 text as a string; other bytes as base64 (RFC 4648 section 4, padded).

flag.description: Every flag of the table in tools/ml/spec.cho, as introspect spells it.

rule.description: Every rule tag ml can emit (the `rules` of spec.cho).
